summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting a change of auditor, effective May 20, 2026, with KPMG resigning and Deloitte appointed as successor. The board and audit committee approved the change; no modified opinions or reportable events occurred in the past two fiscal years. This is a routine auditor change with no special situation such as acquisitions, activist campaigns, or restructuring. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situations event. No deal terms apply.
